description: This is a CSS stylesheet file primarily defining styles for a web application's layout, UI components, theming, and responsive elements. It includes styling for various UI elements such as headers, footers, forms, tables, dialogs, and specific component classes related to a network management or device configuration interface.

classes.name: modal-overlay
classes.description: A class defining a semi-transparent overlay for modal dialogs, covering the entire viewport.

classes.name: modal-dialog
classes.description: A class for the modal dialog box positioning and styling.

classes.name: modalhead-style
classes.description: A class for styling the header of modal dialogs.

classes.name: modalbody-style
classes.description: A class for styling the body content of modal dialogs.

classes.name: popup-style
classes.description: A class for styling popup containers within modals.

classes.name: VQM_div
classes.description: A class for a full-page overlay element, possibly for displaying video quality management UI.

classes.name: VQM_img
classes.description: A class for positioning an image within the VQM overlay, centered on the screen.

classes.name: VQM_module
classes.description: A styling class for individual modules within the VQM overlay.

classes.name: VQM_table
classes.description: A class affecting the font size of tables within the VQM UI.

classes.name: VQM_showhide
classes.description: A display toggle class likely used to show or hide parts of the VQM UI.

classes.name: VQM_width
classes.description: A class setting a fixed width for VQM elements.

classes.name: selfheal_modal
classes.description: A modal dialog class specific to a self-healing feature, with overlay and content styling.

classes.name: module_self
classes.description: A container class for self-healing modules, including styling for headings, shadows, and overall layout.

classes.name: block_self
classes.description: A class for individual block sections within self-healing modules.

classes.name: con_check
classes.description: A class for connection status indicators with embedded images (e.g., LEDs), showing different states.

classes.name: con_check_status_img
classes.description: A class for containers holding status indicator images.

classes.name: p_t60
classes.description: A helper class adding top padding of 60px, likely for spacing layout.

classes.name: selfheal_modal
classes.description: A modal overlay class specific for self-healing dialog boxes.
